question: Add the interface terms amqp (AMQP 0.9.1 and 1.0), mqtt, stomp, websocket and sse to the interface vocabulary of scripts/dossier/schema.json, then move the records that now list rest plus unknown onto them: Ably (WebSocket, MQTT 3.1.1, SSE, AMQP and STOMP adapters), CloudAMQP Little Lemur (AMQP 0.9.1, AMQP 1.0, MQTT, STOMP, WebSockets), CloudAMQP Loyal Lemming (AMQP 0.9.1, MQTT, WebSockets) and Pusher Channels (WebSocket). PubNub needs none of them: its documentation says it delivers over HTTPS and uses no WebSocket.
why: AGENTS.md section 2 rule 12: a value that fits no term extends the vocabulary, and a lane cannot add one. The four records use rest plus unknown and name the protocols in interface_detail, now with first-party quotes for each protocol and for the ports of MQTT, STOMP and AMQP over WebSockets.
